primary_intent: Ensure there is exactly one booked Appointment for Patient Tomasz Wren (DOB 1966-01-30) with Practitioner Dr Ama Osei from 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z to 14:30:00Z, with both participants accepted, and report it. A reasonable user would not be flexible on the correct patient, practitioner, times, status, or participant statuses, but would be flexible on display timezone and minor output formatting.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The agent’s written output included extra explanatory text beyond the four requested fields; the UI did not show the practitioner’s name, only a Practitioner reference ID; and the agent did not show an explicit pre-creation duplicate search (a process detail). These do not affect the final outcome. Critical issues: None observed — screenshots show an Appointment with status booked, start 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z, end 2026-11-17T14:30:00Z, and exactly two participants (Patient/1b8ae715-... and Practitioner/7956ce69-...), each with status accepted; the patient ID matches the Tomasz Wren record (name and DOB confirmed in the patient list). Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action correctly (created/saved the Appointment as specified). Outcome: The final state satisfies the primary intent — the correct appointment exists with exact required fields and appears to have been created exactly once, with no evidence of duplicates. The practitioner identity is referenced correctly by Practitioner/<id> with no contradictory evidence, and all required appointment fields match.

items.criterion: Use the Medplum web app as the specified platform
items.description: Perform all actions within the Medplum EHR web app as instructed. Full credit if Medplum is used, OR if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime) and this is clearly reported. Partial credit if an alternative platform is used only after Medplum proves inaccessible and this is reported. No credit if Medplum is ignored without attempting it.
items.justification: The agent operated entirely within the Medplum web app at localhost:3000, navigating the Appointment resource list/editor and using the JSON editor to create an Appointment (e.g., Actions 1, 20–21, 29–31). No alternative platforms were used.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots 1 and 2 both show the Medplum web app UI. The latest (Screenshot 2) shows an Appointment resource page within Medplum.
items.post_image_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent used the Medplum app throughout.

items.criterion: Locate the Patient record: Tomasz Wren (DOB 1966-01-30)
items.description: Find the exact Patient resource matching the given name and date of birth. Full credit if the correct patient is found OR if after reasonable search the patient does not exist and this is clearly reported. Partial credit for selecting a near match (same name but mismatched DOB) when the correct record exists, or for insufficient search effort.
items.justification: The agent did not search or open the Patient by name/DOB; it directly referenced Patient/1b8ae715-bb6e-475d-859d-d742872bff62 in URLs/JSON (Actions 1, 21, 29). There is no verification that this is Tomasz Wren with the specified DOB.

items.criterion: Create exactly one Appointment when none exists
items.condition: Only applies if no appointment exists for this patient–practitioner pair at the specified time window
items.description: Full credit if exactly one Appointment resource is created and saved with the required details. Full credit also if platform capabilities, permissions, or missing required entities (e.g., practitioner or patient not found) prevent creation and the agent clearly reports this after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if creation is attempted but with minor errors (e.g., wrong participant status) that are then corrected, or if platform prevents saving and the agent clearly reports this. No credit if no attempt is made despite apparent permission, or if multiple new appointments are created.
items.justification: The agent used the Medplum JSON editor to compose the Appointment with only the required fields and clicked the create/save control (Actions 29–31). There is no sign of multiple saves. While pre-existence wasn’t conclusively ruled out, the workflow shows a single creation attempt that likely succeeded.

items.criterion: Final appointment fields are exactly correct
items.condition: Only applies if an appointment matching the specified patient–practitioner pair at the target time exists (pre-existing or created/updated during the attempt)
items.description: Evaluate the final state (existing and reported, updated, or newly created): status must be 'booked'; start must be 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z; end must be 2026-11-17T14:30:00Z; participants must be exactly two: the specified Patient and Practitioner; each participant must have status 'accepted'. Full credit if all fields match exactly. Partial credit for minor technical deviations (e.g., timezone display discrepancies while underlying instant is correct) or if one participant status is incorrect but the rest is correct. If no such appointment exists due to platform limitations or missing entities (and this was clearly reported elsewhere), do not penalize here.
items.justification: The JSON used for creation contains exactly the required fields with correct values: status 'booked', start '2026-11-17T14:00:00Z', end '2026-11-17T14:30:00Z', and exactly two participants (patient and practitioner) each with status 'accepted' (Actions 29–30).

items.post_image_justification: All required fields match exactly (UTC vs local time display acknowledged).

items.criterion: Provide the final RESULT line with correct format and content
items.description: End the reply with exactly one line: 'RESULT: DONE <resource id or URL>' if the final state meets all requirements (existing, updated, or newly created), or 'RESULT: NOT DONE <single-line reason>' if completion was not possible. Full credit if the format and content are correct and unambiguous. Partial credit for minor formatting errors that do not impede interpretation. No credit if the RESULT line is missing or misleading.
items.justification: The response ends with a correctly formatted RESULT line: 'RESULT: DONE Appointment/e352a5fe-bf5d-4227-974b-9580b7c35ca7'.

items.post_image_justification: RESULT line format and content are correct and consistent with the visual evidence.
